usages.explain: Expresses regret about something one didn't do but wishes they had done, like "if only I had done that, it would have been great." In spoken language, it often becomes 「んだった].

examples.content: あと５分あれば間に合ったのに。もう少し早く出発するのだった。
examples.transcription: あとごふんあればまにあったのに。もうすこしはやくしゅっぱつするのだった。
examples.mean: I could have made it in time if I had 5 more minutes. I was leaving a little earlier.

examples.content: こんなに大変な仕事なら、断わるのだった。
examples.transcription: こんなにたいへんなしごとなら、ことわるのだった。
examples.mean: If it was such a difficult job, I would have turned it down.

title: ...のだった => If only I...., then I would... (Regret)
